source.sqlReaderQuery:
select 
'Num' as Num,
'SalesOrg' as  SalesOrg,
'DistributionChannel' as DistributionChannel,
'ConditionType' as ConditionType,
'MaterialNumber' as MaterialNumber,
'MaterialGroup1' as MaterialGroup1,
'PricingGroupCustomer' as PricingGroupCustomer,
'PricingGroupMaterial' as PricingGroupMaterial,
'AmountRate' as AmountRate,
'RateUnit' as RateUnit,
'ConditionPriceUnit' as ConditionPriceUnit,
'ConditionUnit' as ConditionUnit,
'DateFrom' as DateFrom,
'DateTo' as DateTo,
'FileDate' as FileDate,
'PubDate' as PubDate,
'RAW_DATA_ACT_STATUS' as RAW_DATA_ACT_STATUS,
'RAW_DATA_UPDT_TS' as RAW_DATA_UPDT_TS,
'BACH_NUM' as BACH_NUM,
'SRC_SYS_CD' as SRC_SYS_CD,
'REC_CRT_DT' as REC_CRT_DT,
'SRC_SCM_NM' as SRC_SCM_NM,
'SRC_FIL_NM' as SRC_FIL_NM,
'SRC_FIL_DIR' as SRC_FIL_DIR,
'DT' as DT,
'EXP_FLG' as EXP_FLG
union all
-- select * from (
select 
str(Num) as Num,
-- convert(varchar,Num) as Num,
SalesOrg,
DistributionChannel,
ConditionType,
MaterialNumber,
MaterialGroup1,
PricingGroupCustomer,
PricingGroupMaterial,
cast(AmountRate as nvarchar) as AmountRate,
RateUnit,
cast(ConditionPriceUnit as nvarchar) as ConditionPriceUnit,
ConditionUnit, 
DateFrom,
DateTo,
FileDate,
PubDate,
cast(RAW_DATA_ACT_STATUS as nvarchar) as RAW_DATA_ACT_STATUS,
cast(RAW_DATA_UPDT_TS as nvarchar) as RAW_DATA_UPDT_TS,
cast(BACH_NUM as nvarchar) as BACH_NUM,
cast(SRC_SYS_CD as nvarchar) as SRC_SYS_CD,
REC_CRT_DT,
SRC_SCM_NM,
SRC_FIL_NM,
SRC_FIL_DIR,
DT,
EXP_FLG
 from (
select row_number() over(order by MaterialNumber ) as Num,
*
from (
select 
SalesOrg,
DistributionChannel,
ConditionType,
MaterialNumber,
MaterialGroup1,
PricingGroupCustomer,
PricingGroupMaterial,
cast(AmountRate as nvarchar) as AmountRate,
RateUnit,
cast(ConditionPriceUnit as nvarchar) as ConditionPriceUnit,
ConditionUnit, 
DateFrom,
DateTo,
FileDate,
PubDate,
cast(RAW_DATA_ACT_STATUS as nvarchar) as RAW_DATA_ACT_STATUS,
cast(RAW_DATA_UPDT_TS as nvarchar) as RAW_DATA_UPDT_TS,
cast(BACH_NUM as nvarchar) as BACH_NUM,
cast(SRC_SYS_CD as nvarchar) as SRC_SYS_CD,
REC_CRT_DT,
SRC_SCM_NM,
SRC_FIL_NM,
SRC_FIL_DIR,
DT,
EXP_FLG
From [MVIEW].[MIC_SAP_Price]
where SalesOrg in('CN23','CN14') and DistributionChannel='01'
)t 
)a
-- order by Num asc
-- )
